options.name: OpenTimestamps (Bitcoin)
options.anteriority: inclusion in a Bitcoin block; header nTime; backed by proof of work
options.offline_verification: yes IF the 80-byte block header is shipped; caveat: no ready-made headers-only verifier identified
options.python_3_11_windows_and_linux: opentimestamps (LGPL-3.0, last release circa 2022, slow maintenance) plus python-bitcoinlib, pycryptodomex
options.wait_stop: REAL WAIT: the attestation is pending for hours, then ots upgrade. STOP if it is not complete, or if nTime >= T

options.name: RFC 3161 timestamping authority
options.anteriority: genTime SIGNED by the TSA, immediate
options.offline_verification: yes, natively; the TSA certificate and its chain must be shipped
options.root_of_trust: a SINGLE party (mitigable with 2-3 independent TSAs)
options.python_3_11_windows_and_linux: rfc3161-client 1.0.6 (2026-04), Apache-2.0, abi3 Windows and manylinux wheels, PyO3, no network function
options.wait_stop: NO WAIT (synchronous). STOP if genTime >= T, if the imprint differs from the root, or if the chain is invalid
options.why_not: a TSA token is not a registry

options.name: Sigstore / Rekor
options.inclusion_proof: Sigstore v0.3 bundle (inclusion proof plus signed checkpoint)
options.anteriority: WEAK: the Sigstore documentation states that Rekor v1 integratedTime comes from its internal clock and is mutable without detection
options.offline_verification: yes (--offline) but the TUF root must be embedded
options.root_of_trust: the log operator plus TUF; single party for time
options.wait_stop: STOP if inclusion or checkpoint does not validate
options.publication: OIDC identity required (acceptable: verification stays secret-free)
